Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You draw a small sigil over the heart and speak a name into it. The mark stays warm.

Rules

Action
10 minutes
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Up to three willing characters.
Duration
Until used or dawn.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once per day.
Type
Signature

Mark each target with a physical sigil. The first time a marked character would be reduced to 0 HP, it remains at 1 HP instead; the mark then disappears. An unused mark fades at the coming dawn. A character can bear only one mark from this ability.

Additional rulings
